summary: Full UI regression for ConnectMe: intro overlay, scroll constellation, directory purge of demo members, phone register+login (positive & negative), profile edit (name/bio/photo), messaging between two ZZTest users, mobile 390px nav, signed-out /messages, scrollability. All 9 UI checks PASS. Backend pytest ran 11 tests: 10 pass, 1 flaky (test_login.py::test_phone_login_flow passes in isolation, fails intermittently in full suite - potential order/concurrency bug in logout endpoint).

minor.issue: test_phone_login_flow is flaky: in full-suite runs the first device's X-Person-Token sometimes returns 401 after a different device's bearer token is logged out. Passes when run alone. Possible token-store concurrency / state-pollution bug or test ordering issue — needs investigation by main agent.

verified_flows: Intro overlay renders with logo + 'Find People. Build Connections.' animation, detaches within ~3s, and does NOT re-show on second visit same session (sessionStorage key connectme.intro.v1).
scroll-constellation canvas renders behind landing; wheel scrolling works; page scrolls to full height (6012px) with no horizontal scrollbar and no console errors.
Nav shows nav-login-btn + nav-register-btn (Join) when signed out.
Directory lists 16 real members only — no 'Aarav Mehta' / 'Diya Sharma' / 'Demo' badge.
Register ZZTest Alice (+9170123xxxxx) and ZZTest Bob via /register demo OTP: success, no 'demo location request' text in RegisterDone.
After registering Alice, /requests inbox is EMPTY (no auto demo request).
Negative register: sending OTP for Alice's already-registered phone shows 'This phone number is already registered — log in instead'.
Login: /login with Alice's phone + demo code -> redirect to /directory, nav shows Alice profile. Negative /login with unregistered phone shows 'No profile with this number yet — register first'.

Profile page: profile-bio-input works with 160 char limit; changed name to 'ZZTest Alice Edited', typed bio 'Hiking and lo-fi music enthusiast.', uploaded /app/backend/tests/fixtures/avatar.png, saved -> nav avatar is an , directory member-card-bio shows the bio.
Messaging: Alice sent 'Hi Bob from ZZTest Alice' from /messages/<bob_id>; Bob sees message, nav-unread-count badge shows '1'; thread header does NOT say 'demo member'.
Mobile 390px: mobile-nav-login-link and mobile-nav-register-link ('Start registration') visible; /login layout fits viewport.
Signed-out /messages shows register-ish link + Google button.
action_items: Investigate flaky test_phone_login_flow — determine if /api/auth/logout bearer handler is inadvertently invalidating sibling device tokens under concurrent access, or if conftest ZZTest purge races with the test.
Nice-to-have: add data-testid to Messages composer (message-input, message-send-btn) — currently works with generic selectors but testing is brittle.
critical_code_review_comments: IntroOverlay sets document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden' then clears on unmount — if a user hard-navigates during the 2.6s window this still restores correctly; good.

Login/Register share PhoneVerify with purpose prop — nice reuse. One tiny concern: PhoneVerify's 'Send' button data-testid is 'reg-otp-send-btn' even inside the Login page, which is semantically misleading but currently functional.
Profile.tsx bio dirty check uses bio.trim() !== me.bio — if a user adds only whitespace the save button correctly stays disabled; good.
test_credentials: Created two throwaway ZZTest users this run — purged automatically by backend/tests/conftest.py when pytest ran at the end.
seed_data_creation: Two ZZTest-prefixed users created via UI; cleaned up by conftest purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All user-requested flows (intro, scroll bg, login, profile bio, no-demo-members, dup-phone, negative-login) are implemented and work via UI. Only outstanding item is the flaky backend test_phone_login_flow — reproduce by running `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q` twice; it fails roughly every second run. The in-isolation run always passes.
rca of the issue: test_phone_login_flow: logout call targets token2 (bearer) but a subsequent GET /me with token1 (X-Person-Token) returns 401. Need to inspect /app/backend/auth.py logout handler — it may be deleting all sessions for the person, or the conftest's ZZTest purge may be running during the test if session-scoped teardown kicks in while another test's requests are still being processed.
